features: 27-INCH FULL HD IPS DISPLAY: Enjoy an expansive viewing experience with the 27-inch Full HD (1920 x 1080) IPS display. The 16:9 screen delivers sharp visuals, while 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles help maintain consistent image quality from different positions.

165HZ REFRESH RATE FOR SMOOTH MOTION: Experience fluid and responsive visuals with a 165Hz refresh rate, making the Lenovo L27-4r well suited for gaming, fast-moving content, scrolling and everyday multitasking.

1MS GTG RESPONSE TIME: A fast 1ms GTG response time helps minimise motion blur and provides responsive on-screen performance, especially during fast-moving gaming and video content. 99% sRGB COLOUR COVERAGE: With 99% sRGB colour gamut coverage, the monitor delivers rich and accurate-looking colours for everyday content consumption, gaming, photo work and creative tasks.

BUILT-IN STEREO SPEAKERS: Integrated 2 x 3W speakers provide convenient audio without requiring separate desktop speakers, making the monitor suitable for entertainment, video calls and everyday multimedia use.

FOUR-SIDED SLIM-BEZEL DESIGN: The near-borderless, slim-bezel design provides a modern look and helps maximise the visible screen area, making it well suited for both single-monitor and multi-monitor setups.
description: Lenovo L27-4r 27-inch FHD IPS Monitor – Smooth, Vibrant and Immersive Viewing Experience a larger and more immersive view with the Lenovo L27-4r 27-inch Full HD monitor. Its IPS panel delivers sharp 1920 x 1080 resolution, vibrant colours and wide 178° viewing angles, making it a versatile choice for work, entertainment, browsing and gaming. With a 165Hz refresh rate and 1ms MPRT response time, the L27-4r provides smooth, responsive visuals during fast-moving scenes and gaming. Its 99% sRGB colour coverage, 300 cd/m2 brightness and 1500:1 typical contrast ratio help deliver rich colours and clear image details. The monitor features a four-sided ultra-thin design that gives your setup a sleek, contemporary look while keeping bezels slim for a more expansive viewing experience. The anti-glare screen surface helps reduce distracting reflections for comfortable everyday use. Whether you're building a home office, upgrading your gaming setup or enjoying movies and multimedia, the Lenovo L27-4r combines a spacious 27-inch IPS display, smooth performance and modern design for an enhanced everyday viewing experience.
